answer: The admission bond is time locked for 26 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Locks are recorded in wharf, expire in walnut, and lantern lists each expiry. An attacker running 142 aliases therefore needs 183 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. A farm of 1497 identities would post 3089 proofs and burn roughly 72 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
